description: Defines interfaces and classes for mapping and configuring task executors used in the DU-High component of a 5G RAN, including cell and UE-specific executor mappers, configuration structures, and a factory function.

classes.name: du_high_cell_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping cell-specific task executors in DU-High.

classes.name: du_high_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping UE-specific task executors in DU-High.

classes.name: du_high_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing various executors used in DU-High.

methods.name: rlc_lower_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor for RLC-lower events for a specific cell.

methods.name: f1u_dl_pdu_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor for F1-U Rx PDU handling for a specific UE.

methods.name: executor
methods.description: Returns the default UE executor with no specific UE index.
